newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank sets 2-week reverse repo at 16.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank sets 2-week reverse repo at 16.2 pct.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Tuesday it would drain liquidity from the local money market through a two-week reverse repo tender, with maximum yield set at 16.2 percent.
The limit rate was unchanged from a similar operation on Monday, which failed to attract any bids.
The CNB said it would accept two bids from each party totalling at least 100 million crowns before the deadline at 10:10 a.m. (0810 GMT).
